## What will fight you

Two of the six translational gears are removable in three sizes, which is how the operator sets the horizontal scale. The engaged path in the CAD model is a documented kinematic coupling, not a geometric mesh — see `AGENTS.md` and `cad/docs/known-limitations.md` before you take the model's centre distances as gospel.
